why_best: This approach creates an immediate visual hook while keeping the audience fixated on the critical message through a sharp, synchronized visual highlight.
why_bad: Using a progressive wipe or highlighter motion across the phrasing softens the visual impact and drags out a beat that demands immediate clarity.
trap: A superficial attempt will mistakenly animate the accent field as a directional sweep across the phrase rather than transforming the entire block uniformly at once.
